censoring: a mark missing at horizon h is unavailable, never zero; > 20 pct missing = MARKS_INCOMPLETE
clocks: integer microseconds via venue_time.parse_venue_time; book time = snapshot receipt response_end_ts; state time = state row receipt; tape time = venue created_time, read only by phase 2 and the ledger
first_eligible_date_rule: UTC date of the seal commit's committer instant + 1 day
latency_rationale: S = C = 6.0 s is a conservative declared value; decisions are already taken at receipt, so the cadence part is a deliberate margin, not a modelled delay (N2)
ordering: equal receipts form one batch; conflicting touches at one receipt = no decision; at each instant: match resting orders, decide, then submit arrives t+S and cancel ends t+C; a print strictly inside (arrival, end) fills
state_trigger: a state row with state_changed is True (forward_replay.py:108), receipt time
stopping_rule: exactly one confirmatory look: the first receipt at which every non-baseline cell has >= 30 paired games; later receipts are DESCRIPTIVE
tape_completeness: PROVISIONAL when the max drain_watermark of the ticker's trade_backfill_closed rows is earlier than the depth-window end (or absent), or a trade_gap interval intersects it
weighting: game mean = (sum(qty * gross markout) - sum(fee_units)) / sum(qty) in cents; each game one unit; paired by game against static_touch in the same scenario
